mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% signals a deteriorating labor market, reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 8.0%).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in year-over-year CPI inflation and persistently low federal funds rate indicates an imminent policy tightening, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the negative return prediction holds in less than 45% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in housing starts below 950,000 units signals a weakening housing market, reducing consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST declines > 1.0% during late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 95.0 (index 2017=100) indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, reducing corporate earnings and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent decline in quarterly GDP growth and housing starts signals a broad economic slowdown, triggering a sell-off in equities and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the negative return prediction holds in less than 45% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate rising above 2.0% signals a tightening monetary policy, increasing borrowing costs and reducing equity valuations, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth, measured by monthly payroll gains exceeding 100,000 jobs, consistently boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100,000 jobs.
